### Summary

A CUDA kernel cannot call a host function pointer, so kintera keeps a second table of the same named functions
(saturation vapor pressure fits and other user functions) compiled for the device, and looks names up in it before a
launch. The entry point is `get_device_func1` ({{< code src/utils/user_funcs.hpp get_device_func1 >}}).
